channel.title: The New Jungle Tribe
channel.description: Recent content on The New Jungle Tribe

item.title: Action
item.description: “Any medicine will give you the knowledge, confidence and natural calm that you are close to the truth. But it won’t make any move for you. So take the plunge and play some chess. I’m the one influencing minds but I’m not the only one. I do what I can. I can blow the air and make appear a star. I can also make the weather warm and more romantic or melancholic.

item.title: Ayahuasca Origin
item.description: The origin of things. Hard to find when the beginning is something we don’t think it exists. Continuation, more like it. The one who passed the medicine is the same who tried to defend it. A loyal servant to Gaia. He was in charge to protect and make it available for humans and keep the legacy on. Soon to be forgotten. He’d later realize that humans not only are danger, but the ones who would get everything wrong.

item.title: Back to the source
item.description: “You may not have a clue. You may not imagine, but a man is coming with his horse with a very open mindset. He rides like there’s no world to come back. Only one purpose, only one goal pumping his heart. To see you. To come, knock and pray for one more chance. One more time to see the stars, one more time to feel alive. You may not know, but this man loves you like the Sun loves fire.

item.title: Bodytune
item.description: Touch yourself. Feel your body. Feel what you are made of. Feel with intention, with recognition, with magic familiarity and no restriction. Each part of your body is perfectly designed to receive love. Every cell, every inch of your skin has a receptor, a magical antenna directly connected to the source. She’s there, all the time transmitting, all the time singing the beautiful chords of life. Yet sometimes we forget and get still, focusing on vague things.

item.title: Comfidence
item.description: If only the Yacuruna would have heard….If only he knew there were some hunters close by, spying their conversation. Maybe the little warrior could have enjoyed more of his jungle life. I guess The Yacuruna didn’t have super sensitive abilities as their enemies used to believe. One more proof that humans speak bullshit since the beginning of times. The truth is that Yacurunas had different abilities that goes beyond our comprehension.

item.title: Continuation
item.description: “You are continuation. You are the sign things will go on after I’m gone. You are the answer to the mysteries of life. You are the sign that Gaia’s love is infinite. Never stopped, never retracted, always expanding. Soldiers will born and die, but souls will live. That’s our job, that’s the goal of our sacrifice. So be proud and look ahead. Cause we are the proof the image is bigger and the show never ends, no matter what happens everyday.

item.title: Cry
item.description: “It’s ok you can cry, cry as much as you want. I know I’ve been tough, but hey, you’ve been through all, and it was all for your own good. I didn’t mean it like this, you know? It was all supposed to be like this. These are the conditions for life. Fire, suffer, intensity. We all go through this, but not all of us leave from this. It takes courage, wisdom and integration to be able to switch reality and start enjoying it.

item.title: Curse
item.description: “Yes I knew you would have these doubts at some point. Look, If I was wrong once, anyone can be. Remember they are all my children, they are all me, and their ego and the dreams they have will make them think they come from their own world, and they cannot be understood. Wrong. That’s why I’m sending you to this battle. Only you who has loved us since the beginning and suffered infinite times due to our own nature.

item.title: Cursed
item.description: “I see now when I look back, I have been cursed. Because I see your faces, each one of you, and can’t help but feel each one of your fates. No, I didn’t choose this. But I guess this pain will follow me until I get freed. This feeling though, as bad as it seems, is actually needed, for us to stop this sin. All together, no more unconscious. No more sleeping.

item.title: Dark teacher
item.description: In the school of universe there are many kinds of teachers. The moon, the sun, the plants, the frogs and many more. Each one has to be treated with respect and students should approach them properly in a balanced way. Never attending to classes for no reason at all. Never overusing information or any kind of distorting, egotism, or spreading lies. Students are students for a reason, and only when they are called to the Principal, is when they can start switching to a different role.

item.title: Dreams
item.description: “I never ever had this kind of dreams, and I had all kinds. From the most random to the most rational one. But lately dreams feel different. As if they are remnants of different realities. They claim my presence. They want me there as much as this wants me. Not only that, I also want them. It’s impossible to ignore the call. The feeling of belonging and losing. Of not having each other.

item.title: Duty first
item.description: This is a dream, a small fraction of vacation for your soul. And it’s not free, and it’s not forever. That’s why you need to enjoy it as much as you can and stop overworrying in meaningless things. Deep, very deep in your soul you know it, and when you start to experience some kind of discomfort and hard situations in life is when you start remembering that you are actually doing well.

item.title: Elements
item.description: Everything you see is an expression of love. And how is love made for? You know that answer. There has to be intention, passion, intensity. The clash of mountains, the fall of trees. There is no creation that holds still. There is always movement, change. After the thunderbolt has hit and the fire is ignited, there’s no turning back. Transformation happens and the dance of time starts its number. When Gaia made love and realized her true power, her light expanded and covered everything that was in darkness.

item.title: Fear
item.description: “Fear is the biggest tool of the jerk. His name is not even worth mentioning. He will use that tool until the end of it’s days. He’s addicted to it. Expert and master of deceiving. He knows all the power in it. Fear not only changes people, but turns them against each other. Never finding a path, a way out, just running in circles, crashing themselves without a chance to stop.

item.title: Feeling Spines
item.description: There’s a medicine that if not balanced can become a curse. But the kind of curse we all should have. The curse of feeling. The feeling spines of knowledge. The cool teacher. Though less intense and popular than others, this one always comes with style. His manners are soft and likeable, but his wisdom comes in subtle ways. Only the ones truly open, the ones already waking up can fully get his teachings, the beautiful melancholy of life.

item.title: Flame on
item.description: “Even without me, I want you to enjoy life, keeper of the flame. Yes, it’s sad I’m leaving, but you’ll be fine and live a happy life. I’m a timebomb and where I go you can’t go. With so much risk and so many demons, my focus would be you and not my purpose. Do what you know she may do. Live as it’s supposed to. Free and wild, like a bird, like the one you always were.

item.title: Friendship
item.description: “You can’t, they can only believe what their eyes can see. So for now be proud of what you got. Your soul knows and that’s enough. That’s what the medicine is for, so you need to find a way to protect it and when the time comes, bring them back to the source. Yes, it will be hard, cause for them to leave their egos behind, it may take them so many lives.

item.title: Girls are birds
item.description: Women are just birds. This is one truth that has been eclipsed through the whole existence. Another example of humans being dumb. Men has tried every form and way to deprive women from realizing their true power. From burning them to marrying them. Every action driven by ego and not being able to fully gain control over them. You see, girls are untamed, yet they can fall into a never ending dream, believing in the same lies they tell to themselves over and over.

item.title: Granted
item.description: We tend to normalize things as we keep living on a dream. That lightning in the cloud for example. That’s a fight happening right there. That’s love, creation, intensity. That’s someone there fighting the gods with no fear. It’s an answer. That shooting star and clouds that forms at your request, it’s all a blessing. Even more than that. It’s a a battle shout. Everytime you follow your heart and make your ego run, that’s when a little accident happens.

item.title: Hurry
item.description: “I cannot lose any more time now. I need to hurry. Yes it took me some time to realize, but now the path is clear and I don’t have any doubts. The intention and the cause has all filled my soul, now more than a human, I’m a bullet with a goal that can’t be stopped. Yes, maybe I will stagger, maybe I will fall, but the doors I opened now can no longer be closed.

item.title: Interruption
item.description: “There has been an interruption to the party of life. There was love being made by the rhythm of the jungle sounds and got interrupted abruptly. Who dares to do that? Of course the same ones that have been destroying my homeland. The ones that ironically think they are special, different or less evil. They don’t realize they all come from the same place. This time it was not for survival, not by accident.

item.title: Jungle
item.description: “Do you know why I chose the jungle?. I didn’t choose the jungle. The jungle is where I was born. A raw, hard and intense environment. Perfect place for a perfect accident. What could be more ideal? Beautiful and reluctant at the same time. A place that combines fire and mist, storm and sunsets. So much life, everywhere, every second, at your ears, at your shoulders, everywhere claiming what’s theirs.

item.title: Lost
item.description: To be lost for real. That’s when the real journey starts. Of course it’s not ideal. Of course you wouldn’t want it. But this is what the accident of life is about. This is how the old makes space for the new. For growth and experiences. For love and light who is awaiting for us. No doubt and no fear can stop it. Once the call is answered there’s only time between her and us.

item.title: Love goes on
item.description: There was a man who loved women so much that even Gaia couldn’t comprehend it. Thousands of lives lived and died under many names but only one soul. Insane. The most wild, brave and independent of them all, whose passion and intensity could only be matched by creation itself. Gaia was so wise, she always knew, that she was preparing the warrior for one more job. And the warrior what? Does he have a choice?

item.title: Memories
item.description: “Theres a door I like to enter. The door of memories. In times in battle, when body hurts but the soul is intact. I see the stars and close my eyes. The silence. The peace. The comfort. A image draws in the darkness and suddenly colors everything up. Your face shows up and my heart warms up. The laughs, your touch. The comfiest hands and heavenly lap. How I wish I would come back.

item.title: Narrative
item.description: I’m sorry to tell you this. But if you are still living in the same fake old narrative driven by ego, the medicine hasn’t really kicked in. You only know when you wake up. Only when you look back and see how wrong you were, is when things finally start to make sense. And no, there’s no primitive concept that shapes everything together. It’s only love, the only thing you cannot explain and leaves no space for hate.

item.title: Nature friend
item.description: “You may have not noticed. But I do. Life has granted me the experience and blessed my eyes with full capacity of appreciation. I speak from experience and understanding, so this is not just me being corny. Though for you I would be that with no problem. I see you, I see how the light touches your face and the wind blows when you smile. I see how the trees all shake for you to notice, for you to go and hug them.

item.title: Normal life
Party in the jungle
item.description: There is a moment in life for everything. Moments to laugh, moments for crying. Moments to learn, moments for teaching. Time for talking, time to be silent. There are special moments, and they are sacred ones. Now, when we are standing in front of Gaia. When we are in this precious moment, so important, we should be grateful and feel proudly for just being there. Life was so good to us and we were skilled enough to reach this moment of triumph.

item.title: Soul immunity
item.description: “I know you think you have failed. But this doesn’t mean this is over. You need to see the big picture and understand the task is hard, but not impossible. You know how hard was this to happen? How many lives went through multiple decisions and failures? How many accidents, coincidences, and dreams were followed to make the circumstances the way they are now? Nothing is in vane and nothing is left to randomness.

item.title: The end
item.description: The way I feel nowadays is that I have an answer to everything. Sometimes with certainty, sometimes with the most charismatic humbleness. As I’m writing this there’s a question that surfaces my head. I guess the only way I can answer this is at the end of my days. What are cycles for? Are there just little accidents, carried by the power of love, whose only purpose is to help us grow?

item.title: The firing God
item.description: Every-time you tune to the Sun for a minute, and then open your eyes, everything has a different color. The same with every medicine. You may not notice instantly, but life has changed it’s tonality. You see more colors, you feel more balanced. The flower inside you has received light, now is on you to make it bloom. It’s on you to be conscious about it. When you believe and you are honest with your intentions, the Sun may give you the answers you need.

item.title: The jungle Chad
item.description: There was a jungle man who had a special ability that even Gaia got jealous of. He could see more stars than anyone else. This extreme sense of awareness would grant him advantages in hunting, leading the tribe, predicting outcomes and of course, reading girls. Born and raised in the forest, he was the most popular and the most good looking of the village. Not even Yacurunas could be faster than him, as he bragged that he defeated them many times in battle.

item.title: The meeting
The muse
item.description: “You came as the light to my darkness, the answer to my calls. You are the proof of love and what it holds. Still, you shouldn’t come with me. I carry scars and wounds that can’t be closed. The hole in my heart can only be sealed with the end of my days. Still, don’t feel bad for me. I’ve run and I’ve fought all my life. With you I got a pause, a safe spot, a retreat.

item.title: The owning dream
item.description: There is only one way our souls can be finally free. When we are fully aware of our power and we stop living the owning dream. Yes, when we realize there’s nothing to own. Nothing to hold. Nothing is there to lose. We don’t own nature. We don’t own women. We just protect them. Same with knowledge. We are the ones in charge of keeping everything flowing through the right path for the future generations to come.

item.title: The rebel one
item.description: There’s a plant you have, in some other place in the planet. It was one of the most beloved ones from Gaia. Her favorite one, I would say. This plant is unstoppable. Is the terror of the ones who hate, or the ones who impose fear. One day, in one of your lives, you will find it, and you will unlock the current of knowledge that only the source provides.

item.title: The tribe
item.description: “It is not just any potion. It’s the vine of the Gods. Next to this any mushroom or cactus are just for kids. This is Ayahuasca, the medicine, given by Gaia herself. It’s the source and recipe of the whole creation. Everything you see and everything we are is coded into Ayahuasca. The misteries of everything you hear and everything we touch is subtly embedded into the spectrum of the medicine.

item.title: The Warrior
item.description: Hundreds of lives have passed, hundreds of wars. A warrior lives in each of us, so better not to ignore it anymore. At times when it’s all dark and the heart hasn’t healed from many wounds, he’s the one preventing demons from knocking our doors. A voice of intuition. A voice of support. Be careful though, as many words you’ll hear won’t be of your taste at all. Still he’s the one protecting us with so much passion and strength.

item.title: The world
item.description: You want to talk about Ayahuasca? Ok we’ll talk about ayahuasca. To encapsulate a world, how would that be? Yet it seems we live on a capsule. How to explain someone about love? If this person never loved. How can a man know to love? If he never lost her love. There’s a few things in life that we can only learn by ourselves. These are the most important things to learn.

item.title: To learn
item.description: You only swim in waters. That’s the only way to learn. Jump and see, you will realize there was no reason to be afraid. Yes, thought water can be crazy, with Gaia you will be safe. Yes, she can tolerate you being nervous, but don’t think she will stay for long with that vibration. Still, she understands, and wishes you the best. The right time will come for you to understand.

item.title: To light a star
item.description: “I can light a star. But that star won’t fall for you. You may need to follow her all your life. Always loving unconditionally. You may not build her house, but you may make her world a better place. That’s pure love and that’s what you signed for. Every other thing out there are just concepts made out from humans. I didn’t create those. I made love. A whole, pure and magic accident.

item.title: Treason
item.description: “How can it be that men believe more in themselves than in mother nature? Don’t you see every day with your eyes? Who gives the light? Who gives the day and night? Where is your respect? You have gone totally reckless and went against everything I commanded. Not only you destroy my home, where you have been invited as guests, but also start exploting the magic vine under my name.

item.title: Victims
item.description: “I see now we are all victims of life. Why hate? There’s only compassion now. I see you as a kid. As the one dumb kid who once was me. I see the fear, the empty eyes. You haven’t seen, you haven’t noticed yet. Not your fault, so why hate? Not at all. Not in this case. I choose to open and sacrifice, I choose to end this chain of lies.

item.title: Visions
item.description: How can you trick someone into believing what’s right is actually wrong. You need to trick them into a never ending dream. And to do that in humans is actually not that hard. We are naturally programmed with 5 senses. Each one of them can be used to manipulate us. The third eye or the 6th sense many have reffered about, is not actually one extra feature we get when we buy the full version of the game, no, it’s more like a hack.

item.title: What makes a man
item.description: There’s only one truly state of realization of men. And it’s not with money, nor women, nor power. A man is fully realized once it achieves the sacred universal achievement. His contribution to the cause. His answer to the call and protection of the source. What comes with this state is pure soul immunity and inner peace of mind. He no longer lives in a dream, but shaped reality a bit more to the conditions he likes.

item.title: What they want
You are her
item.description: “She has a natural comfy vibe that only comes with truth. You see her, and more importantly, she sees you. See her beauty and surrend to her. Before any hug or touch, just look at her. Look until no sound is heard and the only bump you feel is your heart. She is everywhere. She is inside. You can feel her energy flowing, her divinity unfolding. It covers and protects, everything suddenly makes sense.
